title: wiki.ubuntu.com was replaced by a new deployment, without much of the pre-existing content. This PR updates all the wiki links I could find in this repository with what I believe are the best Ubuntu project documentation replacements.
description:
wiki.ubuntu.com was replaced by a new deployment, without much of the pre-existing content. This PR updates all the wiki links I could find in this repository with what I believe are the best Ubuntu project documentation replacements.

I'm also updating the phased-updater script here, even though it's not the one that runs in production. I'll update that one separatedly.
